verification.existenceBoundary: The timestamped public publication and matching digests demonstrate existence and integrity of the public commercial record as published. verification.futureEconomicReferences: Verify current asset-level maturity sensitivities using the retained methodology; these are not future asking prices or financial-return forecasts.

verification.projectEvaluations: Each of the 105 active software assets has separately dated identity, evidence, rights, financial and handover records. This display publication does not re-execute underlying product tests or independently certify those records.
verification.projectIdentities: Verify 105 unique active identifiers, titles and reference aliases. MyProjects and Projects-Displays are presentation repositories excluded from the IP asset count. Each project has a matching digital display and stable identifiers may contain gaps.
verification.projectConnections: Verify the proposed-connection register, resolve every member against its independent TA-IP asset record, reject project reuse across combinations and recompute both the combined asking reference and recreation-cost total from the current individual financial references. This verifies identities, unique allocation and arithmetic; it does not establish technical integration.
